findings.statement: All twelve minimum 5x3-k3 same-rank contradiction certificates are four-state rectangles with a unique structurally minimal substitution pairing of parity-toggle size two.
The twelve rectangles use four distinct minimal substitution directions: T09438<->T09439 in six rectangles, and T09407<->T09411, T09407<->T09415, T09436<->T09438 in two rectangles each.
The twelve physical certificates collapse to six distinct substitution/context/effect motifs: each structural motif has two physical witnesses in the frozen certificate family.
A one-special-substitution explanation is falsified. Contextual nonlinearity is distributed across at least four component-substitution directions in the 5x3-k3 exact-rank carrier.

Because every minimum witness is a four-row rectangle with a two-type local substitution, a degree-2/pairwise GF(2) interaction model is now a structurally motivated next candidate. This is a warrant to test, not evidence that quadratic terms are sufficient.

nonclaims: The six motif classes are finite 5x3-k3 structure, not a universal theorem.
Unique size-two substitutions do not prove that pairwise terms suffice globally.
No representation refinement is implied because the frozen Q-V carrier remains exact.
next_question: Does an exact-rank quadratic GF(2)^2 decoder eliminate the 5x3-k3 contradictions without changing Q?
